# `funded_interval`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

Immutable prepaid service grants. Persistence foundation only; the future billing owner must atomically post and settle the charge, convert its hold and complete the command.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Retained service grant identity. |
| `product_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Product receiving the grant; coverage cannot overlap for this product. |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Shared prepaid owner of product, command and charge. |
| `currency` | `text` | no |  | Account and charge currency. |
| `rating_type` | `text` | no | `'prepaid'::text` | Constant prepaid, enforced against the account mode. |
| `command_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Idempotent purchase identity; at most one grant per command/product. |
| `command_kind` | `text` | no |  | Order or renewal; transfers cannot grant service. |
| `billing_run_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Retained command run, never a daily run. |
| `applied_rate_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Original recurring charge with exactly matching coverage and quote totals. |
| `charge_type` | `charge_type` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | no | `'recurring'::charge_type` | Constant recurring, enforcing the original charge kind. |
| `authorized_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | Injected actual authorization instant; service is never backdated to midnight. |
| `period` | `daterange` | no |  | Finite nonempty half-open business-date coverage; upper bound is paid-through. |
| `anchor_date` | `date` | no |  | Original calendar anchor retained across renewals. |
| `interval_index` | `integer` | no |  | Nonnegative interval index under the original anchor. |
| `amount` | `numeric(12,2)` | no |  | Exact original charge before tax; immutable and matched to the ABR. |
| `tax_amount` | `numeric(12,2)` | no |  | Exact original tax total; immutable and matched to the ABR. |
| `quote` | `jsonb` | no |  | Immutable price/tax snapshot; the future posting caller validates its structure. |
| `supersedes_interval_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | The earlier grant whose unused dates this mid-period offering change credited; only a grant that supersedes another may overlap it. |
